什么是“北极放大效应”？

What is Arctic amplification?

北极升温速度约为全球平均的3–4倍。主因是海冰融化后深色海面吸收更多太阳辐射（反照率反馈），加上大气与水汽反馈，形成放大。
The Arctic warms roughly 3–4× the global average. Mainly because melting ice exposes dark ocean that absorbs more solar radiation (albedo feedback), plus atmospheric and water-vapor feedbacks amplify it.

北极放大如何可能影响中纬度极端天气（如“极涡”）？

How might Arctic amplification affect mid-latitude extreme weather (e.g., polar vortex)?

北极与赤道温差减小会削弱急流，使其更蜿蜒，导致寒潮南侵、热浪与干旱停留更久。该“遥相关”机制仍有研究分歧。
Reduced pole-equator temperature contrast weakens the jet stream, making it wavier, so cold outbreaks push south and heatwaves/droughts linger. This teleconnection is still debated.
